description: Predict downstream benchmark accuracy across DataDecide model size, data recipe, and training-compute scales.

contract.law_signature: law(input_data: list[dict[str, float]], group: str) -> list[dict[str, float]]

target_description: The response is the source-reported benchmark quantity identified by the `group` label; the law predicts one scalar metric within each group. Representative metric labels are arc challenge, arc easy, boolq, csqa, hellaswag, mmlu abstract algebra, and 60 more.
